title: Mixed Content After SSL
description: Fix insecure http:// assets, padlock warnings, and broken resources after enabling HTTPS on a WordPress site.

steps.title: Audit Mixed Content Warnings
steps.instructions: Open browser DevTools → Console on key pages. List blocked or warned resources still loading over http:// (images, scripts, stylesheets, iframes).

steps.title: Search-Replace http to https in Database
steps.instructions: Use Better Search Replace or WP-CLI search-replace on staging first. Replace http://yourdomain.com with https://yourdomain.com in posts, options, and meta.

steps.title: Update Site URL Settings
steps.instructions: Set both WordPress Address and Site Address to https:// in Settings → General. Add FORCE_SSL_ADMIN to wp-config if admin should always use SSL.

steps.title: Fix Hardcoded URLs in Content and Widgets
steps.instructions: Check custom HTML widgets, page builder sections, and theme options for hardcoded http links. Update logo, favicon, and background image URLs in theme settings.

steps.title: Run SSL Insecure Content Fixer
steps.instructions: Really Simple SSL or similar can rewrite asset URLs on the fly. Use as a bridge while fixing source URLs in the database.

steps.title: Update CDN and External Service URLs
steps.instructions: Reconfigure CDN pull zone for https origin. Update Google Fonts, embeds, and third-party scripts to https versions.

steps.title: Verify Padlock and HSTS
steps.instructions: Confirm no mixed content on homepage, checkout, and login. Test with SSL Labs and enable HSTS only after https is stable everywhere.
